get.summary: Provides the ability to set up and retrieve Scores on Scorecard Results.
get.description: Retrieves the Scorecard Results. Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus Scope: Advanced Compensation

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of objects in a single response. The default is 20. The maximum is 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The zero-based index of the first object in a response collection. The default is 0. Use offset with the limit parameter to control paging of a response collection. Example: If limit is 5 and offset is 9, the response returns a collection of 5 objects starting with the 10th object.

200.description: Successful response. A successful response can return no matched data.

post.description: In the request body, specify these required fields: * compensationScorecard - The Workday ID of a Compensation Scorecard. You can use a returned id from the GET /scorecards method. * evaluationDate - The date when the Scorecard Result is evaluated. Use the yyyy-mm-dd format. Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus Scope: Advanced Compensation

get.description: Retrieves Compensation Scorecard information including the scorecardName, scorecardDescription, inactive status, defaultScorecardGoals, scorecardProfiles containing profileScorecardGoals as of the effective date. The default effective date is the request date. Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus Scope: Advanced Compensation

parameters.description: Effective date the scorecard task takes effect.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of objects in a single response. The default is 20. The maximum is 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The zero-based index of the first object in a response collection. The default is 0. Use offset with the limit parameter to control paging of a response collection. Example: If limit is 5 and offset is 9, the response returns a collection of 5 objects starting with the 10th object.

200.description: Successful response. A successful response can return no matched data.

post.description: Creates a new Compensation Scorecard. In the request body, specify these required fields: scorecardName, effectiveDate, and defaultScorecardGoals[ {goalName, goalWeight} ]. If you specify the optional scorecardProfiles[], you must specify the eligibilityRule{id} and at least 1 goal in profileScorecardGoals[ {goalName, goalWeight} ]. Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus Scope: Advanced Compensation

400.description:
Invalid request. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)

A Default Scorecard \~Goal\~ is missing

A \~Goal\~ is missing for a Scorecard Profile.

Scorecard Name entered has already been used.

The sum of the \~goal\~ weightings must equal 100%.

There are duplicate eligibility rules on this request.

\~Goal\~ Weights must be greater than 0.

get.description: Retrieves Compensation Scorecard information including the scorecardName, scorecardDescription, inactive status, defaultScorecardGoals, scorecardProfiles containing profileScorecardGoals as of the effective date. put.description: Replaces an existing Compensation Scorecard as of the specified effectiveDate. Call GET /scorecards/{ID} to initially populate the request body with the existing data. You can then update the scorecardName, scorecardDescription, and inactive fields. You can also add, update, and delete the existing data in defaultScorecardGoals[], scorecardProfiles[], and profileScorecardGoals[]. Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus Scope: Advanced Compensation

A Default Scorecard \~Goal\~ is missing

A \~Goal\~ doesn't exist as of the Effective Date. Remove or replace the invalid \~Goal\~ or change the Effective Date.

A \~Goal\~ is invalid. Enter a valid \~Goal\~.

A \~Goal\~ is missing for a Scorecard Profile.

Enter an Effective Date that is on or after the first Effective Date of the scorecard: [effectiveDate].

Scorecard Name entered has already been used.

The sum of the \~goal\~ weightings must equal 100%.

There are duplicate eligibility rules on this request.

You can't edit the compensation scorecard [scorecard] for the Effective Date [date] because the latest dated performance results associated with the scorecard is the date [latest date]. Enter an Effective Date for editing the scorecard that is after the following date: [latest date]

You entered duplicate Scorecard Profiles. Replace or remove the duplicates.

You entered duplicate \~Goals\~. Replace or remove the duplicates.

\~Goal\~ Weights must be greater than 0.

post.summary: Request a one-time payment for a worker with the specified ID.
post.description: Creates a one-time payment for a worker with the specified ID, and initiates the Request One-Time Payment business process. In the request body, specify at least these required fields: reason{id}, position{id}, oneTimePayments[ paymentCurrency{id}, oneTimePaymentPlan {id}]. Sample format for paymentAmount: "payment Amount": { "value": "2500" } Secured By Business Process Type: Request One-Time Payment Scope: Core Compensation

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description:
The Workday ID of the resource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).
- **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Employee_ID, Contingent_Worker_ID
- **Named entry**: Valid values: `me`.

If specifying a Coverage Date range, then both dates must be specified.

Only one worktag for each type is allowed for each document line.

Please use a valid One-Time Payment plan.

Select a balancing worktag for Worktags of the following type: [type]

The coverage period End Date must be on or after Start Date.

The following Accounting Worktags are required but have not been assigned: [missing].

The job is not valid for the \~employee\~.

The \~employee\~ you have selected has more than one job. You must supply the job to which this operation applies.
